text: Kyra leans over the map, noticing circles and markings on certain locations. Her fingers trace the inked circles, pausing at each one.
Strange… all these places... they’re all locations where people mysteriously vanished at sea.
But here… there’s a pin… right in the middle of the Atlantic?
She frowns, unease prickling at the back of her mind.
Why would the Captain be studying these spots?
There’s a pattern here... but why?
